bull.text: Broad indexes pared early losses as buyers stepped in; SPY was down about 0.7% at the time of this prediction.

base.text: Dec 1: JOLTS (October). Dec 4, 8:30 AM ET: November jobs report, so the Dec 4 close includes its reaction.
The model's range assumes realized volatility a bit below the options-implied level, since implied vol usually runs above realized.

bear.text: Chip sell-off: Nvidia fell about 8% Wednesday morning after a 5.9% drop Tuesday, and the PHLX Semiconductor Index hit a seven-month low on doubts that AI spending will pay off.
New 20% tariffs were announced and the October PCE report showed price increases picked up, adding rate and growth worries.
The Nasdaq-100 was reported on pace for a bear-market close, which points to fragile sentiment in the AI-linked names that carry much of the index.

notes: Made intraday (about 12:35 PM CT), not at a close. The AI range was written before computing the baseline, but a similar baseline had been seen earlier in the same session, so the comparison is not fully blind.
